title: APA Transmission
summary: Write the APA results sentence straight from R objects: a p-value formatter of your own and sprintf().
hints: `fmt_p <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "< .001" else paste("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))`.
`sprintf()` fills each `%` placeholder with the next argument, in order: eight placeholders, eight arguments.
